name: Double frequency meter
summary: Instrument with two frequency elements showing running and incoming frequency together on a synchronising panel.
description: A double frequency meter shows the frequency of the running system and the incoming machine on one instrument. During manual synchronising the operator adjusts the incoming governor until the two readings match closely, then uses the synchroscope for final phase alignment.

The meter shows frequency only and gives no information on phase angle. Closing with matched frequencies but a large phase difference can still cause a severe disturbance, so it must always be read with the synchroscope or check-synchronising relay.
distinction: A double frequency meter compares frequency; a synchroscope shows the phase difference and its rate of change.
